dedupe_keys.name: cenaos honduras automatic station conditions map and wrf forecast products copeco

description: CENAOS, the atmospheric, oceanographic and seismic studies centre of the Honduran risk management ministry (COPECO), publishes a map of current conditions from automatic weather stations and numerical model forecasts. The current conditions map groups stations by department, from Atlántida and Colón to Valle and Yoro, counts stations reporting good and bad data, and credits data sources including CENAOS, the World Food Programme, the water resources directorate (DGRH), the coffee institute IHCAFE, WWF and others; it warns that the data come from automatic stations and may not be correct. The numerical models page shows WRF forecasts of precipitation and maximum and minimum temperature from the 00 and 12 UTC runs, for the previous and following days. The site also has sections on climatology, hydrology, oceanography and seismology. Access is free online; the site states all rights reserved, and no open licence is given. Caveats: the map loads its readings by script, and the pages are in Spanish. Coverage is Honduras. It supports hazard exposure and emergency response analysis of heavy rain, floods and heat for roads, bridges and water systems; related records are the INDOMET Dominican climate data and the IMN Costa Rica climate atlas and stations.
